description: In front of the hands on a green tablecloth are several small piles of colorful beads, a gray cup, and a dark cord. The left hand pinches a small yellow bead while the right hand brings the cord end toward it, threads the cord through the bead, then lifts the cord upward toward the cup before returning it toward the bead to continue unthreading and rethreading; the bead is a left-hand object and the cord is a right-hand object.
